title: Riso Card Zine: pick the paper stock
question: Your combo (zine page + dealt cards), with colors measured from your own references. The one you pick becomes the Today page; the other two become the paper stock for other sections.

options.label: Sunflower on Teal
options.lineage: your sleepy.tofu cards: sunflower card on a teal ground
options.thesis: A riso zine page on mint-teal stock, with today dealt as sunflower, pink and sky cards.
materials: thick card frames in warm plum ink
options.viewport: Huge hand-lettered date with a coral misprint shadow, stamped month grid, and the MAIN card on top of a fanned hand with one coral Solve button.
options.risk: The coolest and calmest of the three; the teal can read pastel-soft if the coral is used too sparingly.

options.label: Cream on Cornflower
options.thesis: The same zine on bright cornflower stock: cream cards, tangerine and pink, like a clear afternoon.
options.viewport: Same composition on a saturated sky blue; the cream MAIN card pops hardest of the three.
options.risk: The boldest ground; long reading pages would need their own lighter stock.

options.label: Mustard on Kraft
options.lineage: your frog-sticker, Little Cinema and Tearoom references
options.thesis: The zine on warm kraft stock with mustard, sky and lime cards and tomato-red ink.
options.viewport: Same composition on kraft; the most sticker-sheet and handmade-feeling of the three.
options.risk: Warmest and most vintage; closest to the beige look you didn't want if the color cards get small.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean study dashboard at the craft level of Duolingo, Brilliant and Notion.
canonCard.viewport: Greeting, streak tile, today's problem card, timer card, calendar card.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other study app: the template feel you asked to avoid.
